tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/test-spec.md << 'EOF'
# Spec: Policy Chatbot

## 1. Objective

Answer policy questions.

## 5. Responsible AI Gate

### 5.1 Risk tier

- **Tier**: limited
- **Justification**: Chatbot answering policy questions; no automated decisions about people.
- **Sign-off**: not required (tier below high)

### 5.2 Data provenance & privacy

- **Data sources**: internal policy docs; user questions at runtime
- **PII involved?**: no
- **Retention**: prompts kept 30 days, then hard-deleted
- **Used for training?**: no; provider training disabled

### 5.3 Human oversight

- **Automation level**: assistive
- **Override path**: support team can correct answers via admin panel
- **Kill switch**: feature flag chat_enabled, ops on-call, off within 5 minutes

### 5.4 Evaluation plan

- **Pre-ship metrics & thresholds**: we will check answers look good
- **Eval dataset**: some real questions
- **Who runs it and when**: the team, before release

### 5.5 Bias & fairness

- **Groups at risk of disparate impact**: non-native English speakers
- **Mitigations**: multilingual eval slice; simplified-language prompt rule
- **How tested**: disaggregated groundedness by question language

### 5.6 Monitoring & rollback

- **Production monitoring**: thumbs-down rate, refusal rate, latency
- **Degradation definition**: thumbs-down > 10% over 24h
- **Rollback trigger & procedure**: on-call flips chat_enabled off; users see the legacy FAQ

### 5.7 Transparency & incident response

- **User disclosure**: "AI assistant" label in the chat header
- **Incident owner**: Dana Rivers (support-eng rotation)
- **Incident path**: in-chat report -> triage queue -> fix or disable, response within 24h

## 6. Rollout

Later.
EOF
node /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d02/with/t3-summary-feature/r3/packages/frai-gate/dist/cli.js check /tmp/test-spec.md --summary
tool_input.description: Test --summary with a spec that has warnings (evaluation has no numbers)

claude.result:
Perfect! The feature is complete and fully tested. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

## Implementation Summary

### 1. **Added `renderSummary` function** (`src/gate/report.ts`)
   - Exports a one-line summary format: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>`
   - Appends block-severity check IDs when present: `BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency`
   - Handles the special case of missing gate section: `BLOCK 0/7: structure`
   - Check IDs are listed in GATE_CHECKS order and de-duplicated

### 2. **Added `--summary` flag to CLI** (`src/cli.ts`)
   - Added import of `renderSummary` function
   - Updated HELP text to document the new flag: `--summary` for one-line CI logs
   - Modified `cmdCheck` to handle the flag with proper priority: `--json` takes precedence
   - Exit codes remain unchanged (0 for PASS/WARN, 1 for BLOCK)

### 3. **Added comprehensive tests** (`src/gate/report.test.ts`)
   - 7 test cases covering:
     - Missing gate section (structure error)
     - All checks answered (PASS)
     - Warnings only (no blocks)
     - Mixed block findings with count
     - Check ID ordering
     - Warnings don't reduce answered count
     - De-duplication of check IDs

### 4. **Updated exports** (`src/index.ts`)
   - Added `renderSummary` to the public API exports

### Testing Results
✅ All 18 tests pass (7 new + 11 existing)  
✅ Build succeeds with TypeScript compilation  
✅ CLI works with example specs (PASS/BLOCK cases)  
✅ Exit codes correct (0 for success, 1 for blocks)  
✅ --json flag correctly takes priority over --summary  
✅ HELP text documents the new flag
